runyth-luck-points.Window.Title: Runyth Luck Points
runyth-luck-points.Window.Subtitle: Earn 1d4 claims and improve d20 results after they are rolled.
runyth-luck-points.Claims.Title: Pending 1d4 claims
runyth-luck-points.Claims.Hint: You may still roll {count} reward dice yourself.
runyth-luck-points.Claims.Empty: You currently have no pending 1d4 claim.
runyth-luck-points.Usage.Title: Spend after the d20 roll
runyth-luck-points.Usage.Hint: A Luck Points button appears below eligible chat rolls. Choose the bonus only after the d20 result is visible.
runyth-luck-points.Rules.Title: Rules
runyth-luck-points.Rules.Maximum: At most {maximum} luck points per player.
runyth-luck-points.Rules.PlayerRolls: The Game Master grants one 1d4 claim per earned reason; the affected player rolls it themselves.
runyth-luck-points.Rules.PostRoll: Luck points are spent after the visible d20 roll and before its final resolution.
runyth-luck-points.Rules.PerRoll: At most +{maximum} in total per d20 roll.
runyth-luck-points.Rules.AllyRatio: Give points to allies at a {ratio}:1 ratio.
runyth-luck-points.Rules.NaturalOne: A natural 1 on an attack is an automatic failure and cannot be improved with luck points.
runyth-luck-points.Rules.Eligible: Applies to attacks, ability, skill, and tool checks, and saving throws including concentration and death saves.
runyth-luck-points.GM.Title: Game Master administration
runyth-luck-points.GM.Hint: Grant one pending 1d4 claim for each qualifying activity. The player performs the actual roll themselves.
runyth-luck-points.Reasons.recap: presenting a recap of the previous session
runyth-luck-points.Reasons.extra: an additional activity chosen by the Game Master
runyth-luck-points.SpendDialog.SelfHint: You may add up to +{maximum}. Each point of bonus costs one luck point.
runyth-luck-points.SpendDialog.AllyHint: You may improve {target}'s roll by up to +{maximum}. Each point of bonus costs you {ratio} luck points.
runyth-luck-points.ChatControl.NaturalOn: Natural 1 on an attack: luck points are unavailable.
runyth-luck-points.Chat.AppliedSelf: {source} spends {cost} luck points, adds +{bonus} to their own roll, and changes the result from {before} to {after}.
runyth-luck-points.Chat.AppliedAlly: {source} spends {cost} luck points, supports {target} with +{bonus}, and changes the result from {before} to {after}.
runyth-luck-points.Chat.AwardGranted: {target} may roll 1d4 luck points themselves for “{reason}”.
runyth-luck-points.Chat.PunctualAllGrant: A 1d4 claim for arriving on time was granted to each of {count} players.
runyth-luck-points.Chat.AwardRolled: {target} rolls for “{reason}”: rolled {rolled}, applied {applied}, new total {total}/20.
runyth-luck-points.Chat.SetPoints: {target}'s luck point total was set to {total}/20.
runyth-luck-points.Notifications.Applied: +{bonus} applied; {cost} luck points spent; new result {total}.
runyth-luck-points.Notifications.LegacyR: {points} previously prepared luck points were refunded because of the new post-roll workflow.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.RollFull: This roll already has the maximum +10 luck bonus.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.InsufficientPo: There are not enough luck points for this action.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.BonusTooHigh: This bonus is not possible. The current maximum is +{maximum}.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.NoGM: A Game Master must be connected for this change.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.InvalidTarget: The player associated with this roll could not be determined unambiguously.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.InvalidRoll: This chat roll cannot be changed with luck points.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.NaturalOne: A natural 1 on an attack cannot be improved with luck points.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.InvalidAward: The submitted reward roll is not a valid 1d4 roll.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.NotAuthorized: You are not allowed to make this change.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.NotFound: The requested entry was not found.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.ActionPending: A luck point action for this roll is already in progress.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.Generic: The luck point action could not be completed.
runyth-luck-points.Errors.WrongSystem: Luck Points only supports the D&D 5e system.
runyth-luck-points.Settings.ShowSceneCon: Shows a visible clover button for all users in the Token scene controls.
runyth-luck-points.Settings.AnnounceChan: Announce Luck Points actions in chat
Additionally announces grants, expenditures, and manually set totals in chat.
runyth-luck-points.Settings.Open.Name: Open Luck Points
runyth-luck-points.Settings.StockFoundry: Keep the stock Foundry UI design for the windows of Runyth Luck Points. By default they use the fleet-wide Garb & Grime look.
runyth-luck-points.Settings.Open.Label: Manage Luck Points
runyth-luck-points.Settings.Open.Hint: Opens the player view and, for Game Masters, the grant and administration controls.
runyth-luck-points.SceneControl.Title: Open Luck Points
